column1: # Game-object property ids in Anno117.exe (its 0x38-byte property rows) with their names, and PropertyType codes from the shipped Lua stubs (docs/phx-decode.md, Game-object data); the generator is not in this repo.

# Merged: ids are hashes that collide across classes, so an id a later exe names differently keeps the name it had (0x20bd1a05 is the text output's DisplayedSize, not Html); ids a later exe drops stay.
#   kind: PropertyType code (0 bool, 1 int, 3 float, 4 string...); empty for objects and unknown types.
